rawContent: Just quick reminder that this discussion about sexual assault was happening years before #metoo, but y'all didn't care because we didn't have celebrities spamming hash-tags, and it was happening decades before *that*, but y'all didn't care because women and victims had no power.
But the media is out here shouting about #metoo and how shocking this all is like they've been living their whole lives with their fingers in their ears.
